name: Entity Generic
project_description: Entity Generic is a set of reusable base classes and entity handlers that extend the core Entity system and the contributed Entity API (entity) module. Custom modules opt a content entity type into it by adding an 'entity_generic' marker to the entity annotation and pointing the entity's handlers at the Generic* classes shipped here. In return the derived entity type gets ready-made base fields (created/changed, status, label, owner, plus optional archived/deleted/approved flows), a storage handler and storage schema, a list builder, a view builder and templates, content and modal add/edit/delete/toggle-status forms, a route provider that adds modal and merge routes, a permission provider and access control handler that delegate to the Entity API module, Views data with autocomplete/select ID filters and modal-operation link fields, and derived action plugins (enable/disable, approve/unapprove, archive/unarchive, mark/unmark deleted). The features are described by the maintainers as experimental and a work in progress; the project ships only a development branch and has no security advisory coverage.
